status_detail: McDuffie County received a special exception zoning request for a proposed 200-acre, up-to-six-building data center on Randall Hunt Road. DRI final report describes 6 buildings totaling 950,000 sq ft, expected full development in 2029, $1B estimated value, 400 MW demand; WRDW/WAGT reported the county commission passed it 4-1 on March 17, 2026.
notes: County page spells Azalea; DRI materials spell Azelea. DRI application lists developer as Camreon Grogan; DCD reporting links applicant email to Project Turbo LLC. Capacity recorded as 400 MW based on DRI energy demand, with Q&A giving 350-400 MW full build-out.
